title: Round 2 pre-registration: does the AI ideation arm add effective exploration?
status: frozen before any round-2 simulation; a change needs a new dated entry, never an edit

arms.A: estimator-guided search inside the existing design-A families: 20 per round = 14 steered + 4 pure exploration + 2 replicates (ops/propose_round.py)
arms.B: ideation chain naive -> tagger -> senior -> mentor -> Geometry Compiler: <= 5 designs per round, each with an ablation twin (tied screening only)
arms.R: control: 5 random draws from the Design Grammar per round, no language model (ops/grammar_random.py; draws the compiler refuses are discarded and counted)
arms.audit_lane: 1 mentor-rejected idea per round, drawn by code, compiled with minimal repair

distance.space: 12 geometric descriptors of ops/descriptors.py (NAMES), each divided by its standard deviation over the baseline archive meshes (constant ones left unscaled)
distance.floor_rule: largest nearest-neighbour distance between two meshes of the baseline archive: a design is NEW when it is farther from every archive mesh, and from every earlier design of the same round, than any archive design is from its neighbour
distance.random_grammar_reference: 20 random grammar draws (seed 1, d 1.0): 20 beyond the floor, median distance 6.39
distance.note: every one of 20 random grammar draws lies beyond the floor (distances 2.3-11.7 against 0.907): the archive is tightly clustered, so for grammar designs the rule mainly guards against near-copies inside one round; this is why the primary metric also requires PASS

definitions.valid: passes the compiler L0 checks, builds (h14 + h24 preflight), both friction windows reach a usable read-out
definitions.passing: final class PASS under the verdict chain in force when the round is read out (the chain version is recorded with the result)

metrics: build success rate (compiled and preflight-passed / proposed)
PRIMARY: passing-novel designs per design proposed (new by the distance rule AND final class PASS); also reported per GPU-hour
new archive cells (void fraction x mean hard fraction x shape class)
hypervolume gain on (fixation margin, void fraction)
estimator learning gain: change of the leave-one-group-out RMSE of post_ext after adding the arm's data (same model specification)

comparisons.primary: B vs R on passing-novel designs per design proposed (equal counts, 5 vs 5 per round)
comparisons.secondary: B vs A per GPU-hour (A runs 20)
comparisons.claim_rule: no claim of an advantage before 15 designs per arm; round 1 is reported descriptively

experiment_cards.primary_readout: mu_req from tied screening, design vs its ablation twin, both through the same screening pass
experiment_cards.noise_basis: largest difference between screening pass types seen in the archive (0.003-0.006); provisional
experiment_cards.outcomes: confirmed: difference in the predicted direction beyond the floor; refuted: beyond the floor in the other direction; inconclusive: inside the floor or a run not computable
